_doc: Narration for EditorBro: Welcome to the Studio. 'cap' = Roman Hinglish caption, 'tts' = what Liam reads (Hindi in Devanagari, English words in English); phrase punctuation must match (use '.' not '।': the splitter breaks on , . ? ! : …). Each line opens 'scene'; 'min' = minimum scene length, 'pre' = designed silence before the line. Every claim from docs/factcheck.md (F1-F10). bpm = the original score's tempo.

reel.cap: Ye GTA 6 ka trailer nahi hai…
reel.tts: ये GTA 6 का trailer नहीं है…

reel.cap: Ye poora scene code hai. Camera se ek bhi frame nahi aaya.
reel.tts: ये पूरा scene code है. Camera से एक भी frame नहीं आया.

reel.cap: Main bas ek prompt likhta hoon.
reel.tts: मैं बस एक prompt लिखता हूँ.

reel.cap: Claude Code poora studio chalata hai: 64 skills, ek pipeline, aur 12 quality gates.
reel.tts: Claude Code पूरा studio चलाता है: sixty-four skills, एक pipeline, और twelve quality gates.

reel.cap: Reels, 3D films, cartoons, data stories, perfume ads. Bees se zyada reels, isi repo se.
reel.tts: Reels, 3D films, cartoons, data stories, perfume ads. बीस से ज़्यादा reels, इसी repo से.

reel.cap: Aur sirf video nahi. Brand sites, online stores, food delivery, loyalty apps, encrypted chat, automation. Sab yahin se banta hai.
reel.tts: और सिर्फ video नहीं. Brand sites, online stores, food delivery, loyalty apps, encrypted chat, automation. सब यहीं से बनता है.

reel.cap: Har step ka article likha hai. Prompt se lekar final render tak.
reel.tts: हर step का article लिखा है. Prompt से लेकर final render तक.

reel.cap: Repo ka naam: EditorBro. Fork karo, clone karo, apna studio banao. Link chahiye? Comment karo EDITOR.
reel.tts: Repo का नाम: Editor Bro. Fork करो, clone करो, अपना studio बनाओ. Link चाहिए? Comment करो Editor.
